description: We are two teenagers from Malaysia.
summary:
Mars Colony Command is a grid-based base builder game designed to train the next generation of astronauts. With Earth reaching maximum population capacity, humanity faces the challenge of establishing a sustainable home on Mars.

The game addresses this challenge by placing players directly in charge of a simulated Mars colony. Players must build infrastructure, manage vital resources like power and life support, complete tasks, and keep their astronaut crew healthy while repairing buildings and survive sudden disasters like severe dust storms.

This project is important because it makes STEM concepts, resource management, and crisis problem-solving accessible and engaging for young learners. By gamifying the real-world complexities of space colonization, Junior Mars Trainer inspires curiosity and equips future innovators with the strategic mindset needed for deep-space exploration.
details:
• What it does: Mars Colony Command is a free browser game where players act as Mars commanders that build bases, manage power and oxygen, keep astronauts healthy, and survive sudden disasters.
  • Benefits: It turns complex space science into fun, hands on gameplay while teaching resource management and quick problem solving under pressure.
  • Intended impact: To spark curiosity in STEM and inspire kids to become the next generation of space explorers.
  • Tools & tech used: Built and hosted on Base44 using React, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS on standard laptops, informed by NASA’s open Mars climate and terrain data.
  • Creativity: Combines a fun story with real survival challenges instead of a boring textbook or quiz.
  • Factors considered: Made it playable right in the browser with zero downloads, balanced the difficulty so it’s fun for kids, and kept the controls simple and clear.
